entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. To speak to a representative about a new purchase, press three.
(Sound of a button being pressed) Ugh, finally.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF789012. I've been meaning to call for weeks and I'm worried I've missed the window.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up your order... VF789012. Okay, I see it here. You received the VeloBand Pulse about 75 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that's right. So am I too late? I just haven't had a second to deal with this.
Not at all! Don't worry, our standard policy for returns is actually 90 days from the date of delivery.
Wait, really? Are you sure? I could have sworn I read somewhere it was 60 days. I've been stressing about this.
I'm looking at the policy right now. It is definitely 90 days. You have plenty of time left to send it back.
Wow. Okay, that's... a huge relief. Seriously. I was ready for a fight.
No fight needed! I'm happy to help. I can start that return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label. Would that work?
Yes, that would be perfect. Thank you so much! You just took a major weight off my shoulders.
You are very welcome. I've just sent that email with the label and instructions. Your return authorization number is RA456678. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Thank you again for your help, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
